text:
Maya Torres: Nebula asked if we can onboard their 'bytes_window' feed and provide a daily invoice-preview CSV + 5-day shadow run before GA. Who can take the mapping + reconciliation? :wave:

Jun Park: I can own mapping + conversion logic. Need to confirm unit: bytes_window has fields (event_id, device_id, start_ts, end_ts, total_bytes).

Kai (Nebula): Correct, we'll send daily batches to S3 with manifest. We also sign payloads with HMAC. Cutoff should match partner local TZ (they prefer UTC).

Luis Alvarez: Proposed conversion: aggregate total_bytes per entitlement per day, convert to GB-days (bytes / 1024^3), round to 3 decimals. We'll expose both raw_bytes and gb_days in the preview CSV.

Hannah (Marketing): Marketing requests friendly SKUs (e.g., "Nebula Bandwidth — Standard/Pro") mapped in the CSV. Also need two sample previews (low/high) for the marketplace listing.

Jun Park: Shadow plan: 1) Ingest into staging 2) De-dupe by event_id 3) Aggregate per entitlement/day 4) Produce CSV with columns: entitlement_id, sku, period_start, period_end, raw_bytes, gb_days, unit_price_cents, line_total_cents, notes 5) Reconcile vs partner.reported_bytes.

Maya Torres: Thresholds: alert if daily delta_pct > 0.6% or absolute > 250 GB. If a running 5-day window exceeds thresholds, pause GA and open ops ticket.

Luis Alvarez: SQL for daily aggregation (staging):
```sql
SELECT entitlement_id, SUM(total_bytes) AS raw_bytes,
ROUND(SUM(total_bytes) / POW(1024,3), 3) AS gb_days
FROM nebula_staging
WHERE start_ts >= '{{day_start}}' AND end_ts < '{{day_end}}'
GROUP BY entitlement_id;
```

Jun Park: We'll require manifest + signature verification and idempotency on event_id. Also allow 48h backfill window for late events and a backfill job to recompute previews.

ops-bot: Created ticket MP-521: "Nebula bytes_window onboarding + invoice preview" assigned Jun Park.

Kai (Nebula): We'll send sample manifest and two batch files tomorrow. Thanks for the quick plan.

Maya Torres: Action items: Jun -> mapping + sample CSV by Tue EOD; Luis -> staging pipeline + backfill by Wed; Hannah -> marketing labels + sample previews; I'll circulate partner kickoff and confirm UTC cutoff. Reconvene after day 3 of shadow run. :thumbsup:
